Sadda Move Song | Raabta | Latest Hindi Song 2017
Gulshan Kumar and Prem Vijan present Sadda Move Song, in the voice of Diljit Dosanjh and Pardeep Singh Sran composed by Pritam and penned by Irshad Kamil and Amitabh Bhattacharya from the upcoming Indian film "Raabta" a film by Dinesh Vijan and Produced by Dinesh Vijan Homi Adajania Bhushan Kumar Krishan Kumar.The Film stars Sushant Singh Rajput and Kriti Sanon in lead roles with Music by Pritam. The Film releases on 9th June.
